voiceSummary: Systematix Corporate Services Ltd reported consolidated net profit of 1,313 lakhs for Q2 FY27, compared to 1,448 lakhs in Q2 FY26. Total revenue from operations stood at 5,781 lakhs for the quarter. The company closed deals worth approximately 2,350 crore in Q2, including IPOs, QIPs, and M&A transactions. Assets under management increased to 803 crore, while assets under custody reached 12,200 crore. The team strength grew to 38 employees. The presentation highlights a robust pipeline of transactions valued at over 12,600 crore. Financial results for the period ended 30th September 2026 are filed with stock exchanges. The document contains forward-looking statements and is marked private and confidential.

attchmntText: Press Release on the un-audited financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Systematix Corporate Services Limited filed its un-audited financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. Adjusted revenue from operations rose 102% quarter-on-quarter to 56.04 crore rupees. Profit before tax stood at 17.18 crore rupees, while profit after tax turned positive at 13.13 crore rupees. For the half-year ended September 30, 2026, adjusted revenue was 84.06 crore rupees, and profit after tax was 8.24 crore rupees. The company closed 10 investment banking transactions worth approximately 2,350 crore rupees. The asset management team expanded to 38 members with four new offices. The press release was submitted to the BSE and NSE on November 12, 2026.

attchmntText: Disclosure under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 for grant of ESOPS.
voiceSummary: Systematix Corporate Services Limited announced on November 12, 2026, that its Nomination and Remuneration Committee approved the grant of 19,09,179 stock options under the Systematix Employee Stock Option Scheme 2025. The exercise price for these options is Rs. 63.45. The options are granted to eligible employees on terms decided by the Compensation Committee. The exercise period for vested options is a maximum of four years from the vesting date. No options have been exercised or lapsed at this stage. The company filed this disclosure under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations.
